SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Legendary king-hero embodying pastoral leadership, divine favor, perseverance, and bridge between human and divine kingship
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The shepherd who becomes king - humble origins rising to divine status through trials

Correspondences.Color: Shepherd Brown, Royal Gold, Hero Bronze

DevelopmentalArc: Youngest Brother → Left Behind Sick → Divine Recovery → Anzu Friendship → Mountain Trials → Hero → King → Deification → Father of Hero
NarrativeRoles.CyclePhase: Weakness → Abandonment → Recovery → Trial → Triumph → Kingship → Divinity

MythicAppearances: Lugalbanda in the Mountain Cave (left behind sick)
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Patron of shepherds and kings, perseverance invocations, divine favor seeking, royal lineage legitimation, trial endurance rites
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Legendary/possibly historical Early Dynastic king, became divine patron, father of Gilgamesh, shepherd-to-king archetype, influenced humble-origins hero traditions

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as shepherd-king, with crook and crown, in mountain trials, with Anzu bird, recovering from illness, humble yet heroic
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the weakest left behind who became strongest, the shepherd who wore the crown, the perseverer through trials who fathered heroes.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Left alone in mountains recovering impossible strength; befriending the divine bird; the shepherd's crook becoming scepter

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for perseverance, overcoming abandonment, shepherd leadership, humble-to-exalted journey, divine favor, trial endurance
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a shepherd-king left behind as weak who perseveres through trials to divine kingship and fathers the greatest hero.
Create the youngest weakest who becomes strongest through divine favor and perseverance, bridging human and divine.
